name: Cinema
description: Netflix and Spotify style interface with built-in Seerr, Radarr, Sonarr and Aurral support.
overview: A modern replacement front end: Netflix-style home, Spotify-style music, watchlist, Seerr requests and discovery, download progress, release calendar and music requests through Aurral.

versions.changelog: Brand name fix, Aurral discovery shelves, modal cleanup, no-restart interface updates.
